quote.text: People exist for one another. You can instruct or endure them.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Recognize that your interactions build the foundation for your child's growth; nurture them with guidance and compassion rather than mere endurance.
    • Understand that in parenting, patience and instruction go hand in hand—balancing gentle discipline with enduring support helps shape a resilient character.
  • Leadership:
    • Embrace the duty of uplifting those around you; as a leader, you are called to instruct, inspire, and care for your team meaningfully.
    • When faced with challenges, remember that enduring tough moments with calm reflection can forge stronger bonds and foster a more unified vision.
  • Product Management:
    • View your team and customers as essential components of a dynamic ecosystem; instructing your colleagues and stakeholders helps align diverse perspectives towards common goals.
    • In moments of uncertainty or setbacks, practicing resilience and patience—enduring through obstacles—can lead to innovative solutions and a more empathetic product approach.
